answer_2.quote: Table shows the evaluation results. RuleGuider achieves the state-of-the-art results over walk-based methods on WN18RR and NELL-995, and also competitive results on FB15k-237.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation on the Amazon Mechanical Turk. We randomly sample a evaluation set with 300 triples from development set using uniform distribution on FB15k-237. During evaluation, given the ground truth triple, three judges are asked to choose which path is a better explanation/decomposition of it between: 1. path generated by our method. 2. paths generated by Multihop's method. 3. Draw or none of them are reasonable.
answer_4.guideline: three judges are asked to choose which path is a better explanation/decomposition of it
